Coverage

Included: DAI / USDS / sDAI / sUSDS / SKY. Selected Ethereum contracts and reviewed direct methods. Aggregator routes, flash-loan callbacks, arbitrary execution and unreviewed methods are excluded. Token activity is included where identified; this is a lower bound, not complete protocol usage.

Execution gas divided by 21,000. This compares gas demand, not transaction usefulness.
